goal: Dataset personal data check: personal data found in datasets, samples and exports, and where it is kept.
use: Dataset personal data check: personal data found in datasets, samples and exports, and where it is kept. Use when a dataset, sample or export is shared or kept.

steps.note: List the datasets, samples and exports in scope.
Find personal data. Names, contact details, identifiers and location in each field.
Check the copies. Flag personal data in test data, samples and exports shared outside the team.
Check the controls. Each copy needs a purpose, a restriction and a deletion path.
Report. Each dataset with its personal data, the copies and the gaps.
